Characters

Fiskerens sønn gutten · the Fisher Lad

Gutten som vokste opp på residensen etter farens løfte. Han har lært fransk, tysk og protokoll, men ikke å svømme, og havner i Hvittenland i en båt som går av seg selv.

A stocky, wide-shouldered young man of about nineteen with a frank, square face, a bumpy nose, grey-green eyes that crinkle when he laughs, short, wavy brown hair and short brown stubble along his jaw. He wears a chunky, cream-coloured hoodie, dark-blue jeans and tan work boots, and a black phone sticks out of his back pocket.

Den unge kongen (fiskerens sønn) den-unge-kongen · the Young King

Oppdratt ved den kongelige residensen etter et uhyggelig løfte, dras han inn i Hvittenlands prøvelser, vinner en dronning—og mister henne igjen når han bruker en ønskering uten å tenke.

A stocky, wide-shouldered young man of about twenty-one with a frank, square face, a bumpy nose, grey-green eyes that crinkle when he laughs, short, wavy brown hair and short brown stubble along his jaw, dressed like a king: a long dark-navy cloak trimmed with thick brown fur at the neck, over a cream roll-neck jumper, dark trousers and tan boots, with a thin, shiny gold ring on one finger.

Fiskeren fiskeren · the Fisherman

Guttens far, som har levert fisk til kongens kjøkken i tjue år, og som lover bort det han ikke vet at konen bærer på.

A lean, wiry fisherman of about forty-five with a long, weather-beaten face, deep laughter lines, a sharp nose, kind, crinkly blue eyes and a long, drooping black moustache but no beard. He wears a round, brimless old sealskin cap, a thick grey wool jumper, orange oilskin bib trousers and white rubber boots.

Den yngste prinsessen den-yngste-prinsessen · the Youngest Princess

Den tredje av kongsdøtrene som står nedgravd på stranden i Hvittenland. Hun roper ikke på hjelp, men forklarer gutten hvordan søstrene kan bli fri.

A calm, thoughtful young woman of about nineteen with a softly rounded chin, a small nose with a slight upturn, sea-grey eyes under soft brows, a quiet, knowing half-smile and long, wavy golden hair that flows down to her waist. She wears a plain, long-sleeved sky-blue wool dress with a narrow belt of silver links and a thin silver circlet with one pearl.

Dronningen av Hvittenland (den yngste prinsessen) dronningen · the Queen

Den klokeste av tre bundne søstre som kjenner trollenes regler, gir ham veien gjennom prøvelsene og setter én betingelse: at han lytter til faren, ikke moren.

A calm young queen of about nineteen with a softly rounded chin, a small nose with a slight upturn, sea-grey eyes under soft brows, a quiet, knowing half-smile and long, wavy golden hair that flows down to her waist. She wears a slim silver tiara set with pale-blue stones, a long, simple sky-blue gown and a short white faux-fur jacket fastened with a round silver clasp.

Den gamle kongen ved residensen den-gamle-kongen · the Old King

Mannen som reddet gutten som barn og ga ham utdanning og trygghet, men som senere utfordrer ham av stolthet—og utløser tapet ved å kreve å se dronningen.

A skinny, elderly man with a bald, shiny head, a clean-shaven face, a long pointed chin, sharp grey eyes and a thin-lipped mouth with deep lines around it. He wears a peacock-blue three-piece suit with a silk pocket square, a white shirt with a stiff collar, a navy tie and polished black shoes, and carries himself very straight.

Veiviseren på den hvite stranden veiviseren · the Old Guide

En gammel mann i lys, slitt frakk som møter ham i Hvittenland og gir den avgjørende testen: gå forbi de to første prinsessene og hjelp den tredje.

A lean, straight-backed old man of about eighty, as bony and long-limbed as a heron, with a long, narrow, sun-browned face, a hooked nose, bright pale-blue eyes under wild white eyebrows and a long white beard braided into one thin plait with a tiny white shell tied at its end. He wears a battered, pale-yellow oilskin coat that flaps in the wind, a pale sou’wester and tall black rubber boots, and leans on a twisted, silver-grey driftwood staff.

Trollet med ni hoder trollet-med-ni-hoder · the Nine-Headed Troll

Det siste og verste av de tre trollene i slottet. Det kommer den tredje natten med ni hoder og ni ris.

A troll as tall as a house, with a huge, round, lumpy body of creamy-white hide covered in big chocolate-brown patches like a cow's, stumpy legs and big round hands with thick claws. Nine heads grow in a ring around the top of its body like a crown, each with a wide pink snout, small sleepy brown eyes, floppy ears and a wide, grinning mouth. It wears a huge, faded red-and-white checked flannel shirt like a nightshirt.

Nordavinden nordavinden · the North Wind

En viljesterk, talende stormkraft som griper inn når alt står på spill, og gir den unge kongen en brutal, presis plan for å stanse bryllupet.

A tall, lean, long-limbed storm giant, three times as tall as a man, with a long, bony, windburnt face, hollow cheeks, a long thin nose, a wide mouth pursed to blow and bright, shining silver eyes. His wild, tangled slate-grey hair and long, wispy beard stream sideways as if in a gale. He wears a huge, billowing cloak made of dark-grey storm clouds, torn into ragged wisps at the edges, and from the knees down he fades into swirling grey mist.

Picture: In the bright white hall of the castle, with a few musicians tuning their instruments in the background, the Young King, thin and pale, with a scruffy, grown-out brown beard, bows his head to show the Queen the tiny ring fastened in his hair. The Queen, in her white wedding dress, has stood looking at it for a long time; now her face breaks into pure joy.

- the Queen: A calm young queen of about nineteen with a softly rounded chin, a small nose with a slight upturn, sea-grey eyes under soft brows, a quiet, knowing half-smile and long, wavy golden hair that flows down to her waist. She wears a slim silver tiara set with pale-blue stones, a long, simple sky-blue gown and a short white faux-fur jacket fastened with a round silver clasp.
- the Young King: A stocky, wide-shouldered young man of about twenty-one with a frank, square face, a bumpy nose, grey-green eyes that crinkle when he laughs, short, wavy brown hair and short brown stubble along his jaw, dressed like a king: a long dark-navy cloak trimmed with thick brown fur at the neck, over a cream roll-neck jumper, dark trousers and tan boots, with a thin, shiny gold ring on one finger.

Story world: Present-day Norway. The fisherman's small white house stands on the quay of a fjord village below the royal residence, a big modern house behind a tall fence with guards and cameras. His boat is a small white fibreglass fishing boat with an outboard motor and a pair of oars. Far away lies Whiteland, which is on no map: a beach of sand so white it looks fake, between two steep dark mountains, and beyond the trees a low white castle with blue light strips along its roofs. The wishing ring is slim and shiny like a fitness ring; the tiny ring the queen fastens in his hair is engraved. The magic hat, cloak and boots are a tall grey felt hat, a long dark-grey hooded cloak and tall brown boots, and the magic skis are old wooden skis with leather bindings.

Whiteland is dazzling and unreal: brochure-white sand between steep dark mountains, pale turquoise water, a flat white sky and the cold blue glow of light strips, with fresh snow at the wedding. The journey crosses green June country. Accents: ice blue, white and the gold of the rings.

De tolv villendene tolvander · 16/16 pictures

Snehvit-Rosenrød plukker myrull, og hun sier ikke et ord.

Alt: En ung kvinne med kullsvart flette og gummistøvler står på en hvit myr med en sekk myrull. Over henne flyr tolv villender i kveldslyset.

Evening on the White Bog under a pink and gold sky. The Maiden stands among the white tufts of bog cotton with a half-full sack in one hand, her lips pressed together in silence, and looks up as twelve wild ducks fly home low over her head in a long line. Her rubber boots are wet, and a bulging sack stands on a tussock beside her.

Setting:
- the White Bog: A vast, open bog that seems to have no end, so thick with fluffy white tufts of bog cotton that it looks like snow in July, with purple heather, dark pools, mossy tussocks, a small winding stream and a few stunted pines, and a low ridge of dark spruce forest along the far side.

Story world: Present-day Norway. The palace has its own chapel and a big old kitchen. The thirteen silver christening spoons all have the same pattern. As wild ducks, the twelve princes are mallard drakes with glossy bottle-green heads, white neck rings, chestnut breasts and grey backs; as young men they look alike, pale, with tousled raven-black hair, and the eldest is the tallest, with a short black beard. Their cabin lies deep in a vast forest near a great bog. Bog cotton grows in fluffy white tufts, and the caps, shirts and scarves sewn from it are pure white. Behind the garage of the big old white official residence stands a late prime minister's reptile house: a long, low glasshouse with terrariums of snakes and toads under green heat lamps. The three children are two small boys with fair curls and a baby girl with black hair.

Characters

Snehvit-Rosenrød snehvit-rosenrod · the Maiden

Datteren som blir født etter et farlig løfte, reiser alene for å finne sine tolv brødre og syr klær av myrull i full taushet for å bryte forbannelsen—senere blir hun gjort til syndebukk av en mektig stemor.

A slender young woman of about twenty-five with snow-pale skin, rosy-red cheeks and lips, a soft oval face, a small straight nose and large dark-grey eyes with long black lashes. Her raven-black hair is in one thick braid over her shoulder, tied with a piece of garden twine. She wears a worn olive-green work jacket over a plain dark-teal knitted dress, black leggings and black rubber boots, with the handle of a small silver spoon peeking out of the jacket pocket.

Statsministeren statsministeren · the Prime Minister

Landets unge statsminister som finner Snehvit-Rosenrød på myra, tar henne med hjem og gifter seg med henne, men lar seg villede av stemorens iscenesatte «bevis» før han endelig konfronterer sannheten.

A tall, slim man of forty-six, clean-shaven, with a long, friendly face, a straight nose, warm brown eyes, a wide smile and prematurely silver-grey hair swept back. He wears a long dark-navy wool overcoat over a charcoal three-piece suit, a sky-blue shirt, a slim knitted navy tie and brown brogues.

Stemoren stemoren · the Stepmother

Statsministerens maktsøkende stemor som stjeler barna, smører blod for å ramme Snehvit-Rosenrød og driver fram en brutal offentlig «rettferdighet» for å sikre sin kontroll.

A bony, very upright woman in her mid-seventies with a long, pointed chin, a small hooked nose, narrow darting black eyes, thin lips and a powder-pale face with two neat spots of pink blusher. Her steel-grey hair is set in a tall, stiff beehive held with a jewelled clip. She wears a black tailored coat-dress shot with silver thread, a high-necked grey silk blouse, rings on every finger and a small silver compact mirror on a long chain.

Dronningen dronningen · the Queen

Mor til de tolv prinsene og Snehvit-Rosenrød; hennes ubetenksomme hvisking i snøen utløser avtalen som gjør sønnene til villender og legger grunnlaget for datterens lange prøvelse.

A warm, motherly queen of about forty-five with a round face, a soft double chin, a small snub nose, kind hazel eyes, rosy cheeks and wavy chestnut hair going grey at the temples, pinned up in a low bun. She wears a long plum-purple wool coat with a white faux-fur collar over a dark evening dress, a string of pearls, white leather gloves and low black boots.

Den gamle kvinnen den-gamle-kvinnen · the Troll Hag

En gammel kvinne i slitt boblejakke og strikkelue som står til knærne i snøen bak gjerdet, der det ikke går noen vei. Hun lover dronningen en datter, på vanlige vilkår.

A short, stout old woman who is plainly a troll: lumpy, sandy-beige skin, a huge knobbly nose like a big potato, small beady black eyes that are far too alert, a wide crooked grin with three teeth and an enormous crow's nest of black-and-grey hair, stuck with twigs and a black feather, bursting out from under a grey knitted hat. She wears a worn, patched black puffer jacket and big grey felt boots, and a thin cow's tail with a tuft pokes out below the jacket.

Yngstebroren yngstebroren · the Youngest Brother

Den mest medfølende av de tolv brødrene som forsvarer søsteren og blir nesten helt reddet—men bærer en andevinge der venstre arm skulle vært som tegn på prisen.

A slim young man of about twenty-five, the smallest of twelve brothers, with snow-pale skin, a narrow, gentle face, a small straight nose, large dark-grey eyes and tousled raven-black hair that sticks up at the back like ruffled feathers. He wears a faded bottle-green knitted beanie, a worn chestnut-brown wool sweater over a white T-shirt, patched grey work trousers and scuffed hiking boots.

Yngstebroren med andevingen yngstebroren-vinge · the Winged Brother

Yngstebroren når trolldommen er brutt. Skjorten hans fikk aldri venstre erme, så han har en hvit, levende andevinge der venstre arm skulle vært.

A slim young man of about thirty with snow-pale skin, a narrow, gentle face, a small straight nose, large dark-grey eyes and tousled raven-black hair that sticks up at the back like ruffled feathers. He wears a new white cap, a white shirt and a white scarf, all woven from bog cotton, grey trousers and scuffed hiking boots. In place of his left arm he has a large, living white duck's wing that stirs a little when he breathes.

#01 · dronningen, den-gamle-kvinnen
modern · after paragraph 5
«En datter skal du få», sa kvinnen. Hun lente seg inn over gjerdet, så nær at dronningen kjente pusten hennes. Den luktet myr. «Så hvit som snø og så rød som blod. Men da er sønnene dine mine. Du kan få beholde dem til barnet er døpt. Det er vanlige vilkår.»

«En datter skal du få», sa kvinnen. «Det er vanlige vilkår.»

Alt: Dronningen står ved et gjerde langs en snødekt vei med et lommetørkle mot nesen. På den andre siden står ei gammel kvinne med potetnese, strikkelue og slitt boblejakke til knærne i snøen og lener seg inn over gjerdet.

Winter evening on a road out of town, snow falling through the streetlights. A long queue of cars stands still with red tail lights, and far ahead orange snowplough lights flash in the flurries. Beside a big black car with its rear door open, the Queen stands at the roadside fence in her long coat, a tissue pressed to her nose. On the other side of the fence, knee-deep in untouched snow, the Troll Hag leans in over the top rail, close to the Queen's face, with a knowing grin.

#02 · dronningen
modern · after paragraph 10
Dåpen var i slottskapellet. Presten øste vann over hodet til barnet tre ganger og sa amen, og i samme øyeblikk suste det i kirkerommet. Der tolv prinser hadde sittet på første benk, satt det tolv villender. De lettet på én gang, rundet lysekronen og forsvant ut gjennom den åpne døren, inn i snøværet.

In the second pew, three guests in dark suits gape.

#03 · dronningen
modern · after paragraph 21
Etter den kvelden fikk ikke Snehvit-Rosenrød ro. Hun ville av sted, og hun måtte av sted, for dette var jo hennes skyld, alt sammen. Dronningen gråt og ba, men det hjalp ikke. En morgen i april lå mobilen hennes igjen på kjøkkenbenken, og sølvskjeen var borte. Slottet opplyste at prinsessen studerte i utlandet.

En morgen i april lå mobilen hennes igjen på kjøkkenbenken.

Alt: Dronningen står i morgenkåpe ved kjøkkenbenken og ser ned på datterens mobil, som ligger igjen ved siden av en liten, tom eske. Utenfor vinduet ligger slottsparken grå og våt.

- the Girl: A slim, cheerful girl of seventeen with an oval face dusted all over with freckles, a snub nose, big hazel eyes, a wide smile and mousy-brown hair in one thick plait over her shoulder, with a blue jay feather tucked behind one ear. She wears a pine-green knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up, black trousers, a grey work apron with a small blank name badge and sturdy brown boots.
- the Long-Nosed Aunt: A small, hunched old woman of about eighty with a kindly, wrinkled face, sharp, merry little blue eyes, rosy cheeks and an enormous nose, thick as a cucumber at the root and so long that it looks like a carnival mask, ending in a round pink tip. Her white hair is in a small knot. She wears a long moss-green hooded cloak that looks sewn from old velvet curtains, leans on a crooked walking stick, and a black raven rides on her shoulder.
- the Broad-Hipped Aunt: A short old woman of about eighty with narrow shoulders, a small round head and enormously broad hips and backside, so wide that she has to turn sideways to get through a double door. She has a square little face, a snub nose, bright squinting eyes, a gap-toothed grin and grey hair in a tight bun under a small round black felt hat. She wears a huge, bell-shaped skirt with wide red and ochre stripes, a white blouse and a short dark-brown cardigan.
- the Teary-Eyed Aunt: A round-shouldered old woman of about eighty, of middle height, with a soft, wrinkled face and thick glasses with round red frames, behind which her eyes look as big as plates, red-rimmed and always running with tears. Her silver hair is braided and pinned in a ring on top of her head. She wears a dusty-rose dress with a white collar, a red tomato-shaped pincushion on her wrist and a silver thimble on one finger.

Story world: Present-day Norway. The girl grew up in a small, bare log cabin deep in the forest with her father, a hunter, and a chest freezer full of moose. The Palace is big and pale, with a side wing of small staff rooms, cool corridors, a staff canteen and a Great Hall. The Queen grew flax in the Palace Park: pale-gold fibre in big sacks; spun, it becomes fine pale-gold yarn on spools; woven, fine cloth with a blue pattern; sewn, twelve white shirts. Her new spinning machine is a boxy gadget with knobs, spools and a little panel of lamps. The loom is a huge, dark wooden museum piece from the 1700s. The cook wears a white jacket, and the butler a black tailcoat.

Characters

Jenta (den nye assistenten) jenta · the Girl

En fattig manns datter som får jobb i Slottets husholdning, blir presset til å levere håndarbeid hun ikke kan, og ender som brud mens hun bærer på en hemmelig avtale.

A slim, cheerful girl of seventeen with an oval face dusted all over with freckles, a snub nose, big hazel eyes, a wide smile and mousy-brown hair in one thick plait over her shoulder, with a blue jay feather tucked behind one ear. She wears a pine-green knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up, black trousers, a grey work apron with a small blank name badge and sturdy brown boots.

Bruden bruden · the Bride

Jenta på bryllupsdagen. Hedersdagen er kommet, og nå husker hun hva hun har lovet de tre gamle damene.

A slim young bride of eighteen with an oval face dusted with freckles, a snub nose, big hazel eyes and a wide smile, her mousy-brown hair in one thick plait woven with small white flowers and a blue jay feather. She wears a simple, elegant ivory silk wedding dress with long lace sleeves and a small, delicate diamond tiara.

Dronningen dronningen · the Queen

Velvillig, men lett påvirkelig leder av Slottet som elsker tradisjonelt håndarbeid og lar seg overbevise av rykter og «bevis» på talent.

A tall, willowy, kindly queen of about fifty-five with a long neck, a long oval face, crinkly grey eyes, a slightly long nose and dark hair streaked with silver in a low, coiled knot. She wears a sea-green wool dress with a cream lace collar, pearl earrings and a long rainbow-striped hand-knitted scarf, and she is always knitting: two long wooden needles, a half-finished striped scarf and a ball of pink yarn.

Prinsen prinsen · the Prince

En moderne prins som liker jentas ekte væremåte, men blir rystet når «mostrene» avslører prisen av arbeidet og tvinger ham til å ta et tydelig standpunkt.

A tall, slender, polite young man of about twenty-two who blushes easily, with a long, clean-shaven face, a dimpled chin, a long nose with a little bump, earnest dark eyes under thick eyebrows and short, tidy black curls. He wears a deep-teal wool blazer over a white shirt, charcoal trousers and tan suede boots.

Mosteren med den lange nesa moster-langnese · the Long-Nosed Aunt

Den første gamle damen, som spinner alt linet på én natt. Hun har sittet over rokken og nikket og nikket i alle år, og nå er nesa så lang at fotografene tror det er en maske.

A small, hunched old woman of about eighty with a kindly, wrinkled face, sharp, merry little blue eyes, rosy cheeks and an enormous nose, thick as a cucumber at the root and so long that it looks like a carnival mask, ending in a round pink tip. Her white hair is in a small knot. She wears a long moss-green hooded cloak that looks sewn from old velvet curtains, leans on a crooked walking stick, and a black raven rides on her shoulder.

Mosteren med den brede baken moster-bred · the Broad-Hipped Aunt

Den andre gamle damen, som vever alt garnet på én natt. Hun har skubbet seg fram og tilbake på vevbenken siden hun var ung, og nå må hun gå sidelengs gjennom dobbeltdører.

A short old woman of about eighty with narrow shoulders, a small round head and enormously broad hips and backside, so wide that she has to turn sideways to get through a double door. She has a square little face, a snub nose, bright squinting eyes, a gap-toothed grin and grey hair in a tight bun under a small round black felt hat. She wears a huge, bell-shaped skirt with wide red and ochre stripes, a white blouse and a short dark-brown cardigan.

Mosteren med de røde øynene moster-roede-oyne · the Teary-Eyed Aunt

Den tredje gamle damen, som syr tolv skjorter på én natt. Hun har stirret og sydd natt og dag siden hun var lita, og ingen briller hjelper lenger.

A round-shouldered old woman of about eighty, of middle height, with a soft, wrinkled face and thick glasses with round red frames, behind which her eyes look as big as plates, red-rimmed and always running with tears. Her silver hair is braided and pinned in a ring on top of her head. She wears a dusty-rose dress with a white collar, a red tomato-shaped pincushion on her wrist and a silver thimble on one finger.

Husøkonomen husokonomen · the Housekeeper

Husøkonomen har jobbet på Slottet i elleve år og blir fortsatt kalt Berit, selv om hun ikke heter det. Sammen med kokken og hovmesteren finner hun på løgn etter løgn om den nye.

A thin, stiff, tight-lipped woman of about fifty with a narrow, pinched face, pale eyebrows, a sharp little nose, cold pale-blue eyes and ash-blonde hair scraped back into a hard bun. She wears a navy staff uniform dress with a white collar and a small blank name badge, a big bunch of keys at her belt, and carries a clipboard.
